selection_challenges_and_decisions: The five-headline limit required choosing the conditional historical outlook over a separate Q4 guidance-beat headline. Q4 beat, tax detail, EPS and geography were omitted rather than compressed into unsupported shorthand.

The Board needs both group performance and platform dependence. Retained Data Center share and its distinction from the Compute & Networking segment; omitted segment-margin tables and unallocated reconciliation to avoid mixing reporting views.

Cash-flow strength could be mistaken for cash remaining after all investments. Retained the company FCF definition, conversion decline and excluded private-equity/Groq outflows, without presenting undisclosed liquidity sensitivity or adding unlike commitment categories.

Preserved the 0.25 pp net-margin decline and 0.30 pp incremental inventory headwind. A one-page narrative did not justify rounding either to zero or describing growth rates as percentage-point changes.

Margin attribution was a substantive selection challenge: kept management's stated Blackwell/H20 explanation, but also retained the missing causal bridge and undisclosed exact annual net H20/isolated Blackwell effects. Parent review prompted explicit exact and approximately qualifiers for the missing H20 effect and rounded supply commitments, respectively.
Concentration and partner exposure were combined into Board scenarios without identifying anonymous customers, assuming the same customer across periods, or asserting circular revenue.
Stock-based-compensation treatment changes the prospective non-GAAP basis. Retained this warning and a management bridge question rather than reporting unsupported like-for-like non-GAAP growth.
